verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state you can charge customers in over 135 currencies and receive funds in your preferred currency. Payment Links let customers pay in their local currency, and payouts move your available balance to your own bank account. The 'transparent FX handling' part of the story is not evidenced: nothing documents conversion rates, FX fees, or how conversions are shown. Missing for 10: documentation of FX rate/fee transparency and conversion reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-currency settlement.
